# UC-LOGIN-AIC — AIC login (federated through PingOne)

**Track:** demo  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T3 · Sections: §4.1.1

## Buyer Story

Some customers keep their people in PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud — they should sign in there and still get the same governed agent flows.

## PingOne Solution

PingOne stays the authorization server and treats AIC as an external OIDC identity provider: the person signs in at AIC, and PingOne issues the tokens the BFF keeps server-side.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/resource-server","label":"Sign in with AIC, end on the resource server"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `PERMIT`

## What to Say

> Same login, but the person lives in AIC: PingOne sends them to AIC to sign in, then issues its own tokens. Everything after the login is unchanged.
